name: Brownie
summary: Two stacked square chocolate brownies with a crackly top, for dessert, bakery and sweets scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the stack rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (~400 px wide); use about 0.2–0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: bob = gentle up and down, wobble = small rock, pop = scale in with overshoot

author: krakujs
